shared_elements: registers or stacked zones of imagery
decorative bands of repeated motifs (rosettes / geometric fill)
justification: Both show low-relief human figures with elaborate headdresses and profile faces distributed in horizontal registers, with bands of repeated ornament, but that is about as generic as figural relief gets. A shows a processional scene of robed men with weapons beside a horse's head on a flat wall with a row of rosettes, while B is a dense, wrap-around composition of interlocked mask-like glyphic forms and a frontal-faced figure engulfed in ornament, with no shared specific motif or relationship.
